name: Miles Bakshi
biography: Miles Christopher Bakshi is an American actor, known for The Boss Baby (2017), Shrek Forever After (2010) and Shrek the Halls (2007). Son of writer Preston Bakshi and producer Gina Shay. Grandson of Elizabeth (Bassett) and retired animator Ralph Bakshi. Older brother of Nina Zoe Bakshi.
